tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྭྃ: thugs rje chen po don gsal sgron me las: las byang rin chen phreng ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du: dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus kun 'dus pa'i: tshad med thugs rjes 'gro la bu ltar brtse: mgon po spyan ral gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: bdag nyid padma 'byung gnas ngas: ma 'ongs skal ldan don phyir du: bla med don gsal sgron me yi: lam khyer las byang bstan par bya: de yang chog khrigs rim pa la: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bgegs gtor gtang: bka' bsgo mtshams bcad mchod byin brlab: pho brang gzhal yas lha tshogs bskyed: spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal bya: phyi nang gsang mchod dzap bsnyen dang: bstod pa tshogs mchod lhag ma gtang: thugs dam bskul dang chad mdo bdar: brtan skyong dbang gi bro brdung zhing: bsdu chog byas la smon lam gdab: bde legs kun 'byung bkra shis brjod: 'di ltar las rim nyi shu gsum: ma 'ongs skal ldan don du bkod: thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rang byung klong yangs su: gnas lugs brjod bral 'od gsal snying po'i don: ji bzhin mngon gyur spyan ral gzigs dbang la: 'dzin med rang grol chen por skyabs su mchi: zhes lan gsum brjod: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: thugs rje ma 'gags rang gsal dkyil 'khor du: thabs shes 'khril sbyor gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha: longs spyod rdzogs sku rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang bsgral bar sems bskyed do: zhes lan gsum brjod: gsum pa bgegs gtor gtang ba ni: changs bu bslang ba gcig la changs bu bzhis bskor ba sha khrag gis brgyan pa bshams nas: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā ba shuddho3 haṃ: zhes brjod pas stong par sbyang: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas 'di skad do: hūm̐: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs: lan dang bu lon chags pa'i 'byung po rnams:

'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor sgrub mchog 'khor dang bcas pa la: gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa zhi nas rang gnas su: bar chad rtsom byed gdon bgegs khyod song zhig: ces brjod la gtor ma phyir bskyal lo: bzhi pa bka' bsgo ba ni: rang rta mgrin du bskyed la 'di skad do: hrī: nga ni dpal chen khros pa'i sku: gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: bar chad rtsom byed gdon bgegs rnams: thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par byed: oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐: gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐: gṛhṇā pa ya gṛ+-ihṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho bha ga wān: badzra bidyā rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod la rol mo sgrog cing thun gyis brab: drag po'i rdzas bsreg go: lnga pa tshig don gsal bas mtshams bcad pa ni 'di skad do: rang nyid dpal chen thugs ka nas: mtshams gcod 'od zer phyogs bzhir 'phros: 'od zer dkar po 'phros pa las: steng 'og phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i gur: rdo rje 'bar bas mtshams chod la: dri za'i gdon tshogs bsrung du gsol: badzra kro dha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: 'od zair ser po 'phros pa las: steng 'og phyogs mtshams rin chen gur: rin chen 'bar bas mtshams chod la: gshin rje'i gdon tshogs bsrung du gsol: ratna kro dha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa las: steng 'og phyogs mtshams padma'i gur: padma 'bar bas mtshams chod la: klu dbang gdon tshogs bsrung du gsol: padma kro dha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: 'od zer ljang gu 'phros pa las: steng 'og phyogs mtshams ral gri'i gur: ral gri 'bar bas mtshams chod la: gnod sbyin gdon tshogs bsrung du gsol: karma kro dha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: yi dam lha yi thugs ka nas: mchod rdzas dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'phros pa yis: ma dag dri ma bsregs gtor bkrus: yi dam lha yi thugs ka nas: mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phros pa yis: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams: bzang zhing rgya che zad mi shes: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: bdun pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hrī: rang rig hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: rgyal ba mchod cing 'gro don byas: tshur 'dus rang la thim par gyur: rang gi rig pa hrīḥdakar ni: brjod med blo 'das de bzhin nyid: de bzhin nyid la 'phel 'grib med: oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: byang chub sems kyi ngo bo la: gzung 'dzin mtshan mas ma gos kyang: thugs rje 'gag med kun la khyab: stong nyid snying rje'i snying po ni: rang rig hrīḥdakar 'od zer 'bar: de las 'od 'phros rdo rje ni: dkar po rtse lnga pa ru bsgom: de las 'od 'phros 'byung lnga stong: stong nyid bsam brjod mtha' bral klong: rgyal ba'i thugs rje las grub pa: dag pa'i 'byung lnga bskyed pa yi: sa bon yi ge 'bru bdun shar: e yaṃ raṃ khaṃ suṃ ra keṃ: e las nam mkha' mthing 'od 'bar: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos: raṃ las ye shes me dpung 'bar: khaṃ las chu yi dkyil 'khor khol: suṃ las zhing lpags gser mdog steng: ra las rakta dmar nag dbus: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab khar: padma 'dab stong mdzes pa'i steng: bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang: khyams dang gru chad shar dkar la: lho ser nub dmar byang ljang ba'i: rtsigs pa mthing nag dkar ser dmar: ljang ba'i rnam pa lnga dang ldan: 'dod snam pha gu drwa phyed dang: mda' yab pu shu sgo bzhi dang: rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng: chos 'khor gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang: padma dur khrod rdor ra dang: me ri la sogs gzhal yas kyi: phyi nang bkod pa phun sum tshogs: yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar bskyed: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ brgyad pa lha bskyed pa ni: rang byung lhun grub dkyil 'khor dbus: thabs shes zla gam dkar dmar mthar: pad 'dab phyi nang mdzes pa'i khar:

glang chen rta mchog rma bya dang: shang shang bsnol ba'i khri steng du: padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng: rang rig hrīḥyig dmar por bsam: de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus slar yang hrīḥl thim: hrīḥyig yongs su gyur pa las: bcom ldan mgon po 'od dpag med: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dmar: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung la: rtsa phyag dang po mnyam gzhag steng: 'chi med tshe yi bum pa bsnams: phyag gnyis g.yas kyi 'og ma na: mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon 'og padma dmar po bsnams: yum mchog bde chen dbyings phyug ma: sku mdog dmar gsal mdangs dang ldan: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bsnams: g.yon pa dril 'dzin yab la 'khyud: 'khril sbyor bde stong ldan par bskyed: zla gam dkar po'i steng du ni: oṃ las buddha spyan ral gzigs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dkar: zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs pa la: rtsa phyag dang po rdor dril bsnams: phyag gnyis g.yas kyi 'og ma na: me tog dkar po'i phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon 'og padma dkar po bsnams: yum mchog buddha mkha' 'gro ma: dkar gsal mdangs dang ldan pa la: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bsnams: g.yon pas dril 'dzin yab la 'khyud: 'khril sbyor bde stong ldan par bskyed: shar phyogs pad 'dab mthing ga'i steng: hūm̐ las badzra spyan ral gzigs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog mthing: zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs pa la: rtsa phyag dang po rdor dril bsnams: phyag gnyis g.yas kyi 'og ma na: me tog sngon po'i phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon 'og padma sngon po bsnams: yum mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: mthing gsal mdangs dang ldan pa la: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bsnams: g.yon pa dril 'dzin yab la 'khyud: 'khril sbyor bde stong ldan par bskyed: lho phyogs pad 'dab ser po'i steng: trāṃ las ratna spyan ral gzigs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog ser:

zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs pa la: rtsa phyag dang po rdor dril bsnams: phyag gnyis g.yas kyi 'og ma na: me tog ser po'i phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon 'og padma ser po bsnams: yum mchog rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: ser gsal mdangs dang ldan pa la: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bsnams: g.yon pa dril 'dzin yab la 'khyud: 'khril sbyor bde stong ldan par bskyed: nub phyogs pad 'dab dmar po'i steng: hrīḥlas padma spyan ral gzigs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dmar: zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs pa la: rtsa phyag dang po rdor dril bsnams: phyag gnyis g.yas kyi 'og ma na: me tog dmar po'i phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon 'og padma dmar po bsnams: yum mchog padma mkha' 'gro ma: dmar gsal mdangs dang ldan pa la: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bsnams: g.yon pa dril 'dzin yab la 'khyud: 'khril sbyor bde stong ldan par bskyed: byang phyogs pad 'dab ljang gu'i steng: a las karma spyan ral gzigs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog ljang: zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs pa la: rtsa phyag dang po rdor dril bsnams: phyag gnyis g.yas kyi 'og ma na: me tog ljang gu'i phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon 'og padma ljang gu bsnams: yum mchog las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: ljang gsal mdangs dang ldan pa la: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bsnams: g.yon pas dril 'dzin yab la 'khyud: 'khril sbyor bde stong ldan par bskyed: de yi phyi rim 'dab brgyad kyi: shar du oṃ las lha yi ni: thub pa brgya byin sku mdog dkar: pi wang bsnams pa bzhengs thabs bskyed: shar lho mtshams kyi pad 'dab la: ma las lha min thub pa ni: thags bzang rgyal po sku mdog ljang: go mtshon bsnams pa bzhengs thabs bskyed: lho yi phyogs kyi pad 'dab la: ṇi las mi yi thub pa ni: shākya thub pa sku mdog ser: gseg shang lhung bzed bsnams par bskyed: lho nub mtshams kyi pad 'dab la: pad las byol song thub pa ni:

seng ge rab brtan sku mdog mthing: pusti bsnams pa bzhengs thabs bskyed: nub kyi phyogs kyi pad 'dab la: me las yi dwags thub pa ni: kha 'bar rgyal po sku mdog dmar: sgrom bu bsnams pa bzhengs thabs bskyed: nub byang mtshams kyi pad 'dab la: hūm̐ las dmyal ba'i thub pa ni: chos kyi rgyal po sku mdog nag: me chu bsnams pa bzhengs thabs bskyed: byang gi phyogs kyi pad 'dab la: ma las khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs: g.yas pa me dpung g.yon khrus chu: mtshams dang khrus kyi las mdzad bskyed: byang shar mtshams kyi pad 'dab la: a las rnam 'joms sku mdog ljang: g.yas pa khrus bum g.yon me long: nad gdon sdig sgrib sel mdzad bskyed: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: bla med dkyil 'khor shar sgo ru: bi las khro bo rnam par rgyal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar: g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon dril bu: gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par bskyed: bla med dkyil 'khor lho sgo ru: ya las khro bo gshin rje gshed: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser: g.yas pa dbyug to g.yon zhags pa: gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par bskyed: bla med dkyil 'khor nub sgo ru: hrīḥlas khro bo rta mchog dpal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: g.yas pa gri gug g.yon thod khrag: gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par bskyed: bla med dkyil 'khor byang sgo ru: a las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ljang: g.yas pa rgya gram g.yon sdigs mdzub: gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par bskyed: dkyil 'khor chen po'i steng 'og dang: 'khor yug phyogs mtshams thams cad la: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams: 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa lta bur bskyed: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: dgu pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hrī: 'od gsal mkha' dbyings dag pa nas: mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi bdag: o rgyan padma la sogs pa'i: bka' brgyud bla ma spyan 'dren no:

ye shes lnga ldan klong yangs nas: dbang dang byin rlabs kun gyi bdag: spyan ral gzigs dbang rigs lnga sogs: yi dam lha tshogs spyan 'dren no: stong nyid snying rje'i dkyil 'khor nas: thabs mkhas 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa: bcom ldan thub drug la sogs pa: sprul pa'i sku rnams spyan 'dren no: chos kyi dbyings nas khro tshul ston: bar chad 'byung po tshar gcod pa'i: rnam rgyal gshin rje la sogs pa: khro bo'i tshogs rnams spyan 'dren no: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gzhal yas nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho sogs: srung ma'i tshogs rnams spyan 'dren no: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā kā la badzra sa ma ya dza dza: bcu pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hrī: dbyings rig dbyer med thugs rje las: grub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: bla ma yi dam 'khor dang bcas: skyon bral dag pa'i khri la bzhugs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ: bcu gcig pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrī: mi 'jig 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku: 'gag med tshangs dbyangs chos kyi sgras: 'gro ba'i mun pa sel mdzad pa'i: bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: ma bcos mtha' bral chos kyi sku: mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs yab yum 'khril: spyan ral gzigs dbang rigs lnga sogs: yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang ba'i mkha' dbyings nas: bde stong sgyu ma'i gar la rol: dngos grub stsol zhing phrin las sgrub: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo: lung rtogs dam chos dkyil 'khor du: bstan pa srung zhing gdon bgegs 'dul: ye shes mgon po la sogs pa'i: srung ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: bcu gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hrī: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: ho: dag cing gtsang ba'i yid 'ong dung chos nang: yan lag brgyad ldan chu yis rab bkang nas:

spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā: dwangs shing gsal la rnyogs pa med pa'i chu: dri zhim ngad ldan zhabs bsil dam pa 'di: spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā: u dum puṇḍa padma gser chen sogs: 'jig rten khams kyi me tog ji snyed kun: spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā: a kar rgya spos spang spos si la sogs: 'jig rten khams kyi bdug spos ji snyed kun: spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā: nyi zla nor bu sgron me la sogs pa: 'jig rten khams kyi snang gsal ji snyed kun: spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā: ga pur tsan dan dzā ti gur gum sogs: 'jig rten khams kyi dri mchog ji snyed kun: spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā: nas 'bras gro dang til dkar la sogs pa'i: 'jig rten khams kyi zhal zas ji snyed kun: spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra nai bidya pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā: rnga dang sil snyan pi wang gling bu sogs: 'jig rten khams kyi sgra snyan ji snyed kun: spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra shabda pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā:

ྈྈྈྈྈ kun bzang thugs las sprul pa'i ye shes lnga: dug lnga sel phyir bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog: dza gad phud la sbyar ba'i a mṛ ta: spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dzñā na pañtsa a mṛta la khā hi: zag med bde ba'i mkha' dbyings klong chen du: 'dod chags rnam dag bde stong mchod pa'i sprin: dug gsum bsgral ba'i rakta dam pa 'di: spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā rakta sarba pū dza la khā hi: rang byung spros bral chos dbyings ka pā lar: snang srid 'dod yon bza' bca' dpag med sbyar: rig pa rang gsal mchog gi gtor ma 'di: spyan ral gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bcu gsum pa 'dzab bsnyen ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mi mngon chos dbyings gnas mchog nas: kun bzang bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung: 'gro ba'i don du chos sgra sgrog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: po ta la yi gnas mchog nas: spyan ral gzigs dbang bde gshegs gsung: 'gro ba'i don du chos sgra sgrog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog nas: o rgyan padma bde gshegs gsung: 'gro ba'i don du chos sgra sgrog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: klong yangs chos sku'i gzhal yas nas: las 'gro gling pa bde gshegs gsung: 'gro ba'i don du chos sgra sgrog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ āḥhūm̐: yi dam spyan ral gzigs dbang ni: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa'i: sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la: byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: lus ngag yid gsum sgrib dag nas:

sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: kā ya siddhi oṃ: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ āḥhūm̐: wā ka siddhi ā: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tsitta siddhi hūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: bcu bzhi pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hrī: chos sku dbyer med blo 'das pa'i: longs sku gsal stong 'od kyi sku: 'od dpag med mgon yab yum la: dbyings rig dbyer med phyag 'tshal bstod: 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi: kun gzhi'i bag chags sbyong mdzad pa: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: buddha spyan ral gzigs la bstod: 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi: yid kyi bag chags sbyong mdzad pa: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: badzra spyan ral gzigs la bstod: 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi: lus kyi bag chags sbyong mdzad pa: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: ratna spyan ral gzigs la bstod: 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi: ngag gi bag chags sbyong mdzad pa: sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid: padma spyan ral gzigs la bstod: 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi: sgo lnga'i bag chags sbyong mdzad pa: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: karma spyan ral gzigs la bstod: 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi: 'byung ba lnga yi phung po ni: yum gyi bha ga'i klong du sgrol: yum mchog lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod: mgon po spyan ral gzigs dbang gi: sprul pa tshad med thugs rje can: 'gro drug rgyud lnga'i bag chags sbyong: thub pa drug la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs rje chen po'i chu rgyun gyis: 'gro ba'i tsha gdung sel mdzad pa'i: khro bo sme brtsegs rnam par 'joms: khrus kyi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos sku mtshan ma'i yul 'das kyang: gzugs sku khro bo'i skur bstan nas: dkyil 'khor sgo srung gdug pa 'dul: khro rgyal bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: bco lnga pa tshogs las ni: rang nyid spyan ral gzigs dbang thugs ka nas:

raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum tshogs la phog pas sbyangs: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: rang nyid spyan ral gzigs dbang thugs ka nas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phros pas bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: ho: skyon bral thabs shes dngos grub mchog gi rdzas: gsang sngags bla med bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod 'di: bla ma rnams dang dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wā ḍā ki nī ma hā kā la ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa la khā hi: zhes brjod la: rdo rje slob dpon la tshogs 'dren pa ni: slob mas lag pa g.yas g.yon du: bza' ba dang btung ba thogs la 'di skad do: ho: ston pa rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: thabs shes zung 'jug bla med mchod pa'i rdzas: nyes skyon kun bral dag pa'i bdud rtsi 'di: dgyes par rol te dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes 'bul zhing: bla mas lan gsung pa ni: rgyal bas gnang ba'i bcud ldan tshogs mchod 'di: bla ma yi dam dgyes pa'i tshogs su rol: zag med bcud kyis bde stong rgyud la skye: a la la ho ye shes tshogs la rol: zhes brjod: bcu drug pa tshogs lhag ni: lhag gnyis bsdus la nang mchod bran la 'di skad do: ho: gsang sngags bla med dkyil 'khor gyi: bka' nyan lhag sdud gtor len ma: sprul sgyur sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul can: lhag gtor 'di bzhes bstan pa srungs: bcol ba'i phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs: oṃ utstshiṣṭa bhi ta ha ri te bhyo swā hā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bcu bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hrī: rnam dag chos dbyings gzhal yas nas: chos sku 'od dpag med mgon yang: 'gro ba'i don du thugs dam bskul: dbang skur byin gyis brlab tu gsol: rang byung 'od gsal gzhal yas nas: longs sku spyan ral gzigs dbang yang: 'gro ba'i don du thugs dam bskul: dbang skur byin gyis brlab tu gsol: rtsal snang thugs rje'i gzhal yas nas: sprul sku bcom ldan thub drug kyang: 'gro ba'i don la thugs dam bskul:

dbang skur byin gyis brlab tu gsol: me rlung 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas nas: sgo srung khro rgyal dam can yang: 'gro ba'i don la thugs dam bskul: 'gal rkyen bar chad sel bar mdzod: sa ma ya hūm̐: bco brgyad pa chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa dang po chos dbyings gnas mchog tu: 'od dpag med kyis bla med rgyud gsungs tshe: ma mo mkha' 'gros srung mar zhal bzhes mdzad: bka' bzhin mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las sgrubs: bskal pa bar mar bsam yas mchims phu ru: gu ru padmas shog ser bris pa'i tshe: brtan ma sde brgyad bka' yi srung mar bskos: bka' bzhin mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las sgrubs: bskal pa tha mar zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser: thod phreng rtsal gyis las 'phro gling la gsungs: gter srung pho nyas phrin las sgrub par chad: bka' bzhin mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las sgrubs: bcu dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: bhyo: bka' nyan las byed brtan ma'i tshogs: rdo rje kun grags la sogs bdud mo bzhi: sha med gangs dkar la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi: kong btsun de mo la sogs sman btsun bzhi: sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyi nang gsang ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: nyi shu pa rta bro brdung ba ni: hrī: chos dbyings rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: dpal chen rta mgrin khros pa'i bros: gdon bgegs 'byung po rdul du rlog: dbang gi rta skad tse re re: zhabs kyis bro brdung khrigs se khrig: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang 'gong po rnams: chos dbyings klong du mnan par bya: phyi nang gsang ba'i ru tra sarba laṃ nan sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig pa bsdu chog ni: hūm̐: 'byung ba rim brtsegs pho brang gzhal yas khang: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus yab dang yum: chos sku spros bral 'gyur med ngang du bsdu: chos sku'i rtsal las 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir: rang byung dbyings nas slar yang 'byon par mdzod:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra mu: ye shes pa dbyings su gshegs: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o: sa ma ya: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: nyer gnyis pa smon lam ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: gsang sngags bla med dkyil 'khor 'di bsgrubs pas: pha mas thog drangs sems can ma lus kun: thog ma'i mgon po 'od dpag med pa dang: spyan ral gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par shog: nyer gsum pa bkra shis ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis 'gyur ba med: lta ba rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis gsal 'grib med: sgom pa mthar phyin bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis 'gro ba 'dren: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: bdag 'dra mkhar chen mtsho rgyal ngas: bla med don gsal sgron me yi: las byang rin chen phreng ba 'di: o rgyan padma'i gsung bzhin bris: zab mo'i gnas su gter du sbed: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: 'gro 'dul las 'phro gling pa zhes: zab gter chos kyi bdag po 'byung: gter bdag dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis: de la gtod cig sa ma ya: ྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈ
